overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong cross-platform academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a combined follower base of 3,580. Content consistently focuses on computational social science, disinformation, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases (CooRnet), and academic recruitment. Overall engagement is high across all channels, driven by milestone announcements such as paper publications, grant awards, and team hiring.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, paper releases, and conference presentations focusing on computational methods for analyzing platform manipulation.
Major career and research lab announcements, including grant funding success.
Updates on open-source research software such as CooRnet v2.0.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and calls for prospective PhD students.

recommendations: Cross-post high-performing announcements across all three platforms rather than siloing content to maximize reach.
Leverage LinkedIn's higher absolute reach for recruitment posts while fostering interactive discussions on Bluesky and Mastodon.
Include direct links and visual media (infographics, paper cover images) to boost engagement further on publication announcements.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), with strong repost activity indicating high community amplification for research papers and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Yields solid engagement around technical tool updates like CooRnet v2.0, showing a community interested in open-source methods and analytical frameworks.
platformInsights.linkedin: Commands the largest audience (1,850 followers) and yields the highest absolute volume of likes and comments, making it optimal for career opportunities and major institutional announcements.
